clips.title: The story
paras: In Tirisfal Glades, a new Forsaken carries captured Scarlet Crusade documents from Deathknell to Brill. Executor Zygand awaits the courier there.

Executor Arren sends you from Deathknell with captured Scarlet Crusade documents. You have dealt with local threats and intercepted a Scarlet Crusade courier, and are ready for wider service. Leave through Deathknell's sheltered canyon and follow the road east toward Brill, passing Cold Hearth Manor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: These will need to be taken to my superior, Executor Zygand, in Brill. With this information, we'll be able to deal a decisive blow to the Scarlet Crusade. Your services have been useful here in Deathknell, but I need someone to deliver this to Zygand, and I believe he'll be able to find you more appropriate work.
Take the road north out of Deathknell. Soon after entering Tirisfal proper, you'll hit a crossroads. Take the eastern fork, and keep going east. You'll pass Cold Hearth Manor along the way.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, this is very good. You've done well in obtaining this information, friend. Hmm... Names of the officers in the Tirisfal Glades...
Imagine the blow we could deal to the morale of those bloody zealots if we were to kill their leaders in one swift strike.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
